definitions.explanation: Describes an object designed to be wide and low, or oriented left-to-right, as opposed to tall and narrow. Common for appliances, blinds, and screen layouts.

examples.japanese: {横型|よこがた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{冷凍庫|れいとうこ}→冷凍庫：14721_reitouko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{奥|おく}→奥：00980_oku⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{見|み}やすい。
examples.english: A horizontal-type freezer is easy to see into all the way to the back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議室|かいぎしつ}→会議室：01265_kaigishitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{横型|よこがた}⟦ブラインド→ブラインド：04890_buraindo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}いている→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: The conference room windows have horizontal blinds fitted.

examples.japanese: ⟦プレゼン→プレゼン：05505_purezen⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{横型|よこがた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧レイアウト⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made the presentation materials with a landscape layout.

notes:
⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧ (horizontal) + {型|がた} (type): describes anything built or oriented widthwise, left-to-right.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {横型|よこがた}⟦ブラインド→ブラインド：04890_buraindo⟧: horizontal (venetian-style) blinds
- {横型|よこがた}⟦{冷凍庫|れいとうこ}→冷凍庫：14721_reitouko⟧: chest-style (horizontal) freezer
- {横型|よこがた}レイアウト: landscape layout

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{縦型|たてがた}→縦型：30883_tategata⟧: vertical-type — the direct opposite orientation
